items.headline: Rams' jab at Jameis Winston, Giants leads NFL Week 2 trolls
items.description: Teams across the NFL came with petty postgame energy after wins in Week 2, led by the Los Angeles Rams.

items.headline: Rams defeat depleted Giants 28-6 on 'Monday Night Football'
items.description: L.A. exceeded expectations after its Week 1 loss, while New York saw injuries to its stars and couldn't keep up with Matthew Stafford & Co.

items.headline: Davante Adams, Matthew Stafford lead Rams past Giants 28-6 after Jaxson Dart's injury
items.description: — The Los Angeles Rams' dismal season opener in Australia and their proliferating injury woes were nothing Davante Adams and Matthew Stafford couldn't overcome back home with a vintage performance against the Giants.

items.headline: Rams take down Giants 28-6 on MNF
items.description: Rams take down Giants 28-6 on MNF

items.headline: Sources: Giants QB Jaxson Dart believed to have sprained MCL
items.description: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart is believed to have sustained a sprained MCL on Monday night based on initial exams, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo. X-rays were negative and he will undergo an MRI on Tuesday.
